description: Renovate opens PRs for dependency updates (GitHub Actions, container images incl. the one in Bicep); LiteLLM image updates and monthly GitHub Actions updates are merged by GitHub auto-merge.

customManagers.description: Container image in Bicep files (not a format Renovate knows natively)

packageRules.description: LiteLLM: PR opened twice a month (1st and 15th, 01:00-07:00), merged by GitHub auto-merge once CI passes; the deploy workflow rolls it out. Versions, release dates and digests are looked up on Docker Hub (litellm/litellm-database, the same images and digests as on ghcr.io), because ghcr.io has no publish dates; the files keep pulling from ghcr.io
LiteLLM: a new digest for the same tag means the tag was re-pushed; that waits for a human review
GitHub Actions: all updates bundled into one PR, opened once a month (1st, 01:00-07:00), merged by GitHub auto-merge once CI passes
GitHub Actions major versions (e.g. checkout v7 -> v8) still wait for a human review
